implementation: Extends the pinned existing scoped connection with typed Unit.Job (uo) reads; no native loader or new ABI symbol.
Reads own-unit Job before and after the existing invocation-bracketed Unit/Service samples; failed samples invalidate the service token.
Checks zero-ID/root-path sentinel and exact nonzero job-ID/path pairs; observed jobs never enter submission/cancellation allowlists.
Terminal evidence requires the exact known invocation, current job absence, zero main PID/inactive-or-failed observations, and separately queried known submitted job IDs.
Strict named NoSuchJob required; raw errno, other names, late replies and request cleanup failures cannot become absence.
Existing original-worker session is connected through the real adapter code with simulated C ABI replies. Cgroup ownership and emptiness remain explicit test doubles.
testEvidenceNotes: New module first failed on missing implementation; this is not a behavioral red-test proof.
A new terminal helper originally omitted existing unit/profile checks; six subcases reproduced acceptance before guards were added.
A raw-errno injection initially targeted the wrong fake function attribute; corrected to the fixture actual function field, then rejection verified.

Negative combined test deliberately exhausts simulated original 10-second budget; asserts 9.99 to 10.0 seconds, no quiescence/artifact removal/cleanup success, and no new manager or bus-close attempt after sticky failure.
The negative fixture accepts only its explicitly recorded identical close_failure; raw failure evidence and artifacts are retained.

Final selected batch has 43 adapter/schema/compatibility cases including all 23 legacy scoped-connection assertions, 2 coupled session cases, 25 staged-session, 29 reader and 142 existing-session cases. Counts are not summed across reruns.
limitations: Returned job facts do not prove cgroup empty, unit ownership, manager/library/socket provenance or namespace isolation.
The current Unit.Job and tracked submitted IDs are checked; no global job enumeration is performed.
Cgroup disappearance is not treated as emptiness; a verified native group lifecycle reader remains pending.
A simulated message table with no entries is not evidence that a connection was closed. Failed final-budget cleanup remains failed.
Local selected suites only, not full project or native runtime acceptance.
Historical AddRef contract failure remains separately recorded, not rerun or resolved.
synchronization: Sanitized evidence only; no private adapter source, raw diagnostics or credentials.
